risks.risk: Games mismatch: seller lists FIFA 24/FIFA 26 and other titles, but photo shows only a FIFA (appears to be FIFA 22) case.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo/video of the full game list with the actual game cases/discs laid out (front covers visible) or a screenshot of the installed games on the PS4 menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS4 Slim with 2 controllers and only the clearly shown FIFA game (other games treated as not included).

risks.risk: Console may not be fully working (disc drive, HDMI, USB ports, Wi‑Fi/Ethernet, controller charging).
risks.proof: Request a short video: power on → home screen → open settings → show network status → plug in both controllers and show they work → insert a disc (or show disc drive test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fully working (worst case: treat as basic console with limited functionality).

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original or faulty (drift, weak vibration, button issues).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of controller model/label and a video showing both controllers working in-game/menu (including analog movement and button presses).
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers included but not guaranteed perfect (worst case: treat as standard used controllers).

risks.risk: Receipt/UK proof not shown; could be missing or not genuine.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the UK receipt (with sensitive details blurred) and/or the console serial number label photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price without any value added for receipt/proof.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo/video showing all included games (front covers/discs visible) matching the seller’s list.
Send a power-on video to the PS4 home screen plus a quick settings check (network) and confirmation both controllers work.
Show a disc-drive test (insert a disc and play/load) or a video proving the disc drive reads.
Provide a photo of the UK receipt and a close-up of the console serial/model label.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS4 Slim with two controllers and at least one FIFA case, but they do not verify the seller’s full game list, nor do they prove the console is fully working (ports/disc drive/overheating). Missing decisive proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
